properties.name: Guan Yu's ride: Xu → Dongling Pass
properties.name_zh: 千里走单骑：许都 → 东岭关
properties.text: Chapters 27–28. Kills Kong Xiu at Dongling Pass. None of it happened, and none of these men is in the histories. Dongling Pass is placed approximately; the novel gives no location.
properties.text_zh: 第27–28回。在东岭关斩孔秀。史书并无此事，这些守将也都不见于史书。东岭关位置为示意，小说未说明所在。
